faq.q: How much does Wattel & York charge?
faq.a: Wattel & York publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Wattel & York offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Wattel & York publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Wattel & York have offices?
faq.a: Wattel & York publishes five offices, in Mesa, Phoenix, Yuma, Tucson and Peoria. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Wattel & York?
faq.a: Wattel & York names ten attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Arizona does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Wattel & York?
faq.a: Wattel & York scores 41 and sits at Verified. Passed: website and footprint. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure, discipline and entity registration. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
